heading: H. RESOLVE DUPLICATE VACCINATION EVENTS BUSINESS PROCESS NOTES AND ANNOTATIONS

tasks.name: Identify groups of vaccination events for evaluation
tasks.description:
- Events (or groups of events) are evaluated using predefined criteria (e.g. encounter date, vaccine type and trade name, provider name, record source type, vaccine lot number, etc.).
- Potential duplicate events are identified and grouped within a client’s record.

tasks.name: Evaluate vaccination event records
tasks.description:
- Records are reviewed individually to determine if the recorded events are duplicates.
- Vaccination events within a client’s record are reviewed individually to determine if the recorded events are duplicates or are unique events.
- The potential duplicates are marked or classified as potential duplicate and are flagged for resolution.
personas: Vaccination location Health worker or System administrator

tasks.name: Duplicate events?
tasks.description: - A classification is made to determine if the events are duplicates.
personas: Vaccination location Health worker or System administrator

tasks.name: Select the most accurate/suitable event record
tasks.description: - For events that match, the most accurate/suitable event is selected based on level of confidence, completeness of data and specificity of data. This step can be performed manually or by the PCPOSS.
personas: Vaccination location Health worker or System administrator

tasks.name: Update vaccination event records
tasks.description:
- All available information is aggregated from the duplicate events into an updated event.
- The updated event will be made available to view and utilize in the client record. All reported events should be kept on file along with a documented audit trail so de-duplication decisions can be analysed.

tasks.name: Generate report of duplicate vaccination events
tasks.description: - PCPOSS generates a report of duplicate vaccine events, and potentially the resolution, if appropriate. The report is printable and can be exported to several formats.
